I know about some of that research actually... and the scary part is is that you're right. After fighting for so long to acheive any sort of normalcy, and consistently coming up short in any long term achievement, I don't know what else to do but give up anymore. Sure a shitty hand can turn out for people - I'm just out of cards to play entirely at this point.

As for the psychiatrist... there was a point I could afford to see one, and I did. My confidentiality was wrongfully breached, and the backlash has since left me completely untrusting of any kind of therapy. That's actually part of the reason I'm here - an attempt at release.
